sources: RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 (8 May 2025): loan sirf bank / RBI-registered NBFC se; KFS pehle; contacts/gallery access mana; paisa seedha bank account mein; apps ki list RBI CIMS par public. Complaint: sachet.rbi.org.in, 1930.
